newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares end mixed, second liners lead action.
newsitem.headline: KL shares end mixed, second liners lead action.

text.p: Second liner counters stayed at the forefront of the Kuala Lumpur stock market action, while blue chips finished on a soft note amid stronger volume, dealers said on Monday.

After an early gain evaporated, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Composite Index finished down 3.11 points to 1,116.37. But the punter-dominated Second Board ended up 9.56 points to 20.99 after striking a new high of 522.48.
"The speculative stocks are raging away, but the index-linked and front liners were down a bit," observed Ami Moris, a vice president in dealing at Capitalcorp.
Tin stocks grabbed some attention after tin plater Perstima was suspended pending an announcement. Perstima gained 1.00 to 11.90 ringgit prior to the suspension on Monday.
A.H. Tin added 27 cents to 5.15, Petaling Tin rose 1.90 to 19.90 and Berjuntai Tin gained 1.10 to 16.90.
Volume topped 208 million shares, compared with 176 million on Friday. Losers edged out gainers by 270 to 265.
In futures trading, the spot month ended up 0.9 point to 1,114.4, on 169 contracts. The September futures contract slipped 0.5 to 1,112.9, on turnover of 152 contracts.
